C0990.title: “Friendly” Account Lending Turns Accomplice: Hekou Branch Cracks Payment-Aiding Case
C0990.summary: In October 2025, the Hekou Branch cyber police unit uncovered multiple fraud operations linked to lent social media accounts while investigating an online fraud case. The original account holder, Jiang, lent his account to a former colleague, Liu, out of personal obligation.
